item.description:
MAMAMOO 2019 CONCERT 4season F/W in DAEGU (1080p HD)​


​
The 2019 MAMAMOO CONCERT [4season F/W] is MAMAMOO's third concert tour, and their third concert tour for the Four Seasons, Four Colors project. The "F/W" in the tour's title is the abbreviated form of "Fall/Winter", as this tour covers the seasons of fall and winter in the 4season project after the releases of Solar and Whee In's assigned albums: BLUES and White Wind. Previously, a year-end concert was to be held to appease the disappointment of the short period of promotional activity for BLUE;S, titled the "2018 MAMAMOO CONCERT [4season F/W]".
